gaps.explanation: After 'in' a noun is needed: excitement (-ment noun).

gaps.hint: noun needed after 'signs of'; note the spelling change
gaps.explanation: After 'signs of' a noun is needed: recovery (the -er of 'recover' becomes -ery).

gaps.sentence: The firefighter was given a medal for her ___ (HERO).
gaps.explanation: 'Her heroism' — the quality noun follows the possessive.

gaps.sentence: Heavy snow made the mountain road ___ (PASS).
gaps.hint: negative adjective needed: impossible to travel through (im- + -able)
gaps.explanation: Heavy snow blocks the road, so the negative adjective 'impassable' (im- + pass + -able) is needed.

gaps.sentence: I'm afraid your passport is ___ — it expired last month (VALID).
gaps.hint: negative adjective needed: it has expired
gaps.explanation: An expired document is invalid (in- + valid); an adjective is needed after 'is'.

gaps.hint: subject of the sentence: noun needed (-ness becomes -ty here)
gaps.explanation: The subject must be a noun: Honesty. The spelling changes -ness to -ty; 'honestness' is not a word.

gaps.sentence: The festival celebrates ___ (CREATE) in every form.
gaps.explanation: 'Celebrates creativity' — the abstract quality noun follows the verb.

gaps.sentence: He had a happy ___ in the countryside (CHILD).
gaps.hint: noun needed: the period of being a child (-hood)
gaps.explanation: The suffix -hood forms period-of-life nouns: childhood.
